sources: Bhagavata Purana, Canto 6, chapters 1-3 (Ajamila's fall, his son Narayana, the Yamadutas, the Vishnudutas, the discussion of the holy name, Ajamila's repentance and Haridwar).

en.title: The Man Who Called His Son's Name | Ajamila
en.description:
He said one word at the end of his life. And it saved him.

Ajamila called out his son's name, Narayana, which is also a name of Vishnu.

Retold from the Bhagavata Purana, Canto 6, chapters 1-3.
